Harper Teebs is a Harper who patrols the southern side of the Last Light Inn docks during Act Two.
“
Nice to see the dark's spitting out more than shadows. Welcome.
„
— Teebs

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Teebs is at the Last Light Inn, where he is patrolling the southern side route of the docks area, with  Naysa patrolling in the opposite direction.

Resolve the Abduction

When  Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, Teebs more often than not fails his saving throw and is  Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Teebs and everyone in the inn turn into  Shadow-Cursed Undead, save for  Jaheira.

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Teebs follows Jaheira to Moonrise Towers. However, Teebs is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. His corpse is in Moonrise Towers, down the staircase leading down from the entrance, in front of  Disciple Z'rell.
